title: Quick Sauteed Malaysian Beef Stir-fry
description: A quick and spicy one-pot Malaysian dish featuring blue food colouring and lardons-render. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the lardons in a wok over medium-high heat until they start to render, about 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips to the wok and cook until browned, about 4 minutes.
Add the minced ginger and garlic to the wok and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the coconut aminos, blue food colouring, and fish sauce to the wok and stir to combine.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions to the wok and cook until slightly tender, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Serve immediately and garnish with toasted coconut flakes if desired.
